content.short: Avail is a robust base layer for next-generation trust-minimized apps and sovereign rollups.
content.description: Avail is a robust base layer designed for next-generation trust-minimized applications and sovereign rollups. Its security model lets light clients verify data availability by sampling over a peer-to-peer network. Avail's modular design simplifies blockchain integration by removing the need to manage validator sets or tokenomics, and it supports zero-knowledge or fraud-proof-based applications with greater efficiency and ease for developers.
